messages:
Olivia Park: Quick check: in the relevance table the selected row highlight is very faint on dark mode. QA flagged contrast fail for the selected state.
Samir Khan: Hmm. We're using a 6% overlay. Should bump to meet 4.5:1 contrast for text inside the row and 3:1 for the focus ring.
Becca Lin: While we're here, can we make the relevance badge read as a percentage when spoken? e.g., "Rerank score 0.87" -> "Rerank score 87 percent" for clarity.
Carlos Ruiz: Export nuance: when users map columns during export, we currently show only field keys. Suggest showing both key + example value in the mapping dropdown so they know which metadata will be exported.
Olivia Park: Great idea. Also add a small "Preview first 3 rows" link inside the mapping modal that renders a tiny table.
Samir Khan: Accessibility-bot: keyboard nav issue: after opening mapping modal, pressing Tab cycles through inputs then escapes focus to background. We need focus trap.
accessibility-bot: Recommendation: Use role="dialog", set initial focus on the first mapping select, and restore focus to the Export button on close. Announce "Mapping modal opened" via aria-live.
Becca Lin: Copy tweak: change modal header from "Map fields" -> "Choose export columns". Shorter and clearer. Primary CTA: "Export now". Secondary: "Save mapping" (for reuse).
Carlos Ruiz: Backend note: add named mapping support as POST /exports/mappings {name, columns: []}. Later export calls reference mapping_name to avoid remapping each time.
Olivia Park: UX: default mapping should include preview_text, rerank_score (rounded to 3 decimals), and metadata.owner if present. Hide vector numeric data behind an "Include embeddings" disclosure.
Samir Khan: Small perf rule: when user requests "Include embeddings" for >1000 rows, force job flow and show estimated size. Show warning: "Large downloads may take several minutes."
Becca Lin: Visual hint: when a mapping is in use show a pill next to Export: "Mapping: quick-support" with a dropdown to switch. Makes it discoverable.
accessibility-bot: Ensure mapping dropdown is keyboard accessible and announces current mapping. When saving mapping, announce "Mapping saved" and provide link to manage mappings.
Olivia Park: OK I'll mock the mapping preview, contrast adjustments, and copy changes and attach to ticket DX-4250. Will ask Eng to add mapping API. Thanks!
